caption:
Chilli Oil Lettuce Wrap Burger

Nutrition: 
with burger bun, 
C: 56 | F: 11 | P: 37
Calories: 424 per serve ( for 1 burger)
Makes 3 burgers

for lettuce wraps, 
C: 18 | F: 10 | P: 32
Calories: 265 per serve (for 1 lettuce wrap)
Makes 3 lettuce wraps

Ingredients
for the burger patty, 
450 grams chicken mince	
2 sprigs spring onion 
1 tbsp minced garlic 
1 tbsp chilli oil, i like to use more mix and less oil 
1 tsp black pepper
1 tsp dark soy sauce
salt, if you need it, i dont use any
1 egg, optional for extra protein 

for assembly, 
3 - 4  burger buns  OR a full head of lettuce for the wraps 
1 tsp chinsu sauce ( basically vietnamese chilli sauce) or use any you have on hand :) 
sliced tomatoes
1 tsp relish per burger

Method
combine all the ingredients for the burger patty in a bowl and set aside 
smash 3 patties in the pan and cook till done, this can take anywhere from 10-15 mins depending on the size of the patties
assemble your burger with your favorite toppings
